title: Main
description:
In Quantum C, all programs only need one thing to start: the `main()` function. While i will cover functions later, all you need to know is:
- A: All programs start at the first line of the `main` function
- B: The main function signature is `int main() { code... return 0;}.
The main function will look like:
```cpp
int main() {
    code...
    return 0;
}
```

---
## Assignment: 
Make the code work by wraping it in the `main` function.
starterCode:
qout("I am in the main function and I work.\n");
return 0;
expectedOutput: I am in the main function and I work.
